values.note: Every site has water and electric; sites 18-25 have 50 A and sewer.

hookups.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/barnwell/camping ('Each site is packed gravel and includes individual water and electrical hookups'; 'Campsites 18-25 have 50 amp electrical hookups and sewer hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 17 water/electric and 8 full-hookup sites (18-25) on packed gravel; four take RVs up to 36 ft, the rest up to 28 ft. Camping clubs may reserve up to 20 sites.

sites.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/barnwell/camping ('Four sites accommodate RVs up to 36 feet, others up to 28 feet'; 'Standard Sites with Elec. & Water: 17 sites'; 'Camping clubs may reserve up to 20 sites') + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/barnwell/campsites ('the 25 campsites'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/barnwell/camping ('restrooms with hot showers'; 'A dump station is available for RVs'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; per AWH's firsthand report on the agency row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights per site (42 of 49 cumulative). Same-day reservations go through the park. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://southcarolinaparks.com/barnwell/camping ('Camping reservations must be made for a minimum of two nights'; same-day via the park) + https://reserve.southcarolinaparks.com/barnwell/campsites (policies: 'Reservations may be made up to 13 months in advance', 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 nights per site', check-in 2:00 p.m.), read 2026-10-21; single-night phone waiver from the state:SC row's AWH firsthand note

note: CCC-built park with three small fishing lakes; the campground is a short walk from them. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 25 sites (17 W/E + 8 full hookup with 50 A, #18-25), RVs to 36 ft (4 sites) / 28 ft, showers, dump; booking confirmed with the 13-month window, 2-night minimum (AWH phone waiver) and 14-night max, now on the entry. The derived fcfs some_sites (from the note's 'walk-ins') left alone: the pages only say same-day bookings go through the park. Fees left as read 2026-10-11. Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: season, pull-throughs.
